about.title: See where your money goes. Decide where it goes next.
about.body: Ooga is a budgeting app for families. It brings everyone's spending into one place, so you get a real picture of where the money goes and stay in control of the bottom line every month.
about.whyBody: Most budgets fail quietly: nobody knows the number until the month is over. Ooga keeps it in front of you while you can still do something about it.
about.readyBody: The guide walks you through it step by step, from your household to your first trends.

household.title: One household, everyone in it
household.body: Invite your partner with an invitation code and share one budget. Mark each transaction with the family member it was for, kids included.

budget.title: A budget that fits your month
budget.body: Give each category a monthly limit. Adjust a month when life happens, and keep a history of every version.

bank.title: Your bank, without the typing
bank.body: Import transactions from Visa Cal and Discount Bank. Ooga skips duplicates and matches each charge to the transaction you entered by hand with "Paid with" set.

trends.title: The trend, not just the total
trends.body: Insights compares your budget with actual spending, tracks how fast each category is moving and shows who spends what, month after month.

landing.newBody: Create your account in a minute; your household comes with it. The guide shows you every step.

editor.deleteOnly:
⚠️ DELETE YOUR ONLY BUDGET ⚠️

This will return you to the initial setup state with no budget configured.

You will need to create a new budget to continue using the app.

This action cannot be undone.

Are you sure?
editor.deleteActiveConfirm:
Are you sure you want to delete the ACTIVE budget?

This will permanently remove this budget and all its settings. Another budget will be automatically activated.

This action cannot be undone.
editor.deleteOtherConfirm:
Are you sure you want to delete this budget?

This action cannot be undone.
editor.resetConfirm:
⚠️ RESET BUDGET CONFIGURATION ⚠️

This will PERMANENTLY DELETE:
• All your personal budgets ({{budgets}})
• All budget configurations and settings

You will also be asked about:
• Monthly budgets (historical budget snapshots)
• Transaction data (all your transactions)

This will bring you back to the default state, as if you just created your account.

Are you absolutely sure you want to continue?
editor.deleteMonthlyQuestion:
Do you also want to delete ALL monthly budgets?

Monthly budgets are historical snapshots of your budgets for each month.

Click OK to delete them, or Cancel to keep them.
editor.deleteTransactionsQuestion:
⚠️ FINAL QUESTION: Do you want to delete ALL transactions?

This will permanently remove all your transaction history.

Click OK to delete ALL data, or Cancel to keep your transactions.
editor.resetTail: You can now create a fresh budget!
